title: AlifBee — Curated MSA Audio-First Path
design: Fresh-start curated course. Learn the useful beginner vocabulary and concepts from this course from the beginning, then continue by prerequisite rather than publication date. Use non-AlifBee grammar/listening sources only when this audio path has a genuine gap.

items.title: Arabic Basics for Beginners: 10 Must-Know Essentials to Start Learning
items.rule: Treat this as the true beginning of the current course. Add useful vocabulary and concepts learned here even if similar material existed in a removed prior deck.

items.title: How to Say Hello in Arabic: Complete Guide to Arabic Greetings
100 Common Words in Arabic
items.rule: Do not create 100 cards automatically; add high-frequency/generative items that are actually taught and useful.

items.title: How to Tell the Time in Arabic: A Beginner’s Guide
6 Helpful Arabic Phrases to Say Sorry
Days of the Week in Arabic (MSA + Dialects) with Audio & Real-life Phrases
items.msa_rule: Extract MSA into the core deck; label dialect forms separately and do not merge them into MSA answers.

items.title: Basic Vocabulary to Talk about Weather and Seasons in Arabic
Arabic Root System: How Arabic Words Are Built From Root Letters
50 Easy Arabic Words for Beginners
items.rule: Select useful vocabulary actually encountered; do not mass-import every listed word.

after_order_10: Continue curating the live AlifBee MSA podcast by prerequisite and concept gaps. Interleave LQToronto/Madina for deeper grammar and DLI GLOSS/other verified audio for later graded listening.
completion_protocol: On complete/finished, verify the exact episode, extract/deepen useful Arabic cards and audio-review scripts, update spaced review, then advance to the next appropriate audio item.
